goal: Run the complete Valkey lifecycle with directly managed native processes on multiple ECS hosts through exact real 50-node and 200-node executions.

criteria.statement: Host inventory accepts explicit local and SSH endpoints, rejects duplicate hosts, assigns nodes deterministically, and preserves host identity in orchestration artifacts.
The native_multi_ecs backend starts and owns directly managed Valkey processes on at least two ECS hosts without using the local Docker runtime as a substitute.
A real multi-ECS full-flow run requests and independently observes exactly 50 healthy Valkey nodes without downscaling.
A real multi-ECS full-flow run requests and independently observes exactly 200 healthy Valkey nodes without downscaling.
Cross-host clocks, process journals, command logs, evidence transfer, provenance, and product bindings are complete and attributable.
Distributed fault handling, recovery, teardown, cost accounting, and cleanup preserve ownership and leave no managed process or host resource behind.
